mapper.sql: id, student_no, test_no, question_no, student_score, question_score, question_type, flag, create_time, grader_no, locked_at
mapper.update: update score_detail set student_no = #{studentNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, test_no = #{testNo,jdbcType=BIGINT}, question_no = #{questionNo,jdbcType=BIGINT}, student_score = #{studentScore,jdbcType=INTEGER}, question_score = #{questionScore,jdbcType=INTEGER}, question_type = #{questionType,jdbcType=CHAR}, flag = #{flag,jdbcType=CHAR}, create_time = #{createTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, grader_no = #{graderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, locked_at = #{lockedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, student_answer = #{studentAnswer,jdbcType=LONGVARCHAR} where id = #{id,jdbcType=BIGINT}
mapper.select: SELECT sd.student_answer AS studentAnswer, t.name AS testName, CASE WHEN sd.question_type IN ('1','2','3') THEN c.question WHEN sd.question_type = '4' THEN s.question ELSE '未知题型' END AS questionContent, CASE WHEN sd.question_type IN ('1','2','3') THEN c.answer WHEN sd.question_type = '4' THEN s.answer ELSE 'N/A' END AS correctAnswer, '' AS analysis FROM score_detail sd LEFT JOIN test t ON sd.test_no = t.id LEFT JOIN choice c ON sd.question_no = c.id AND sd.question_type IN ('1','2','3') LEFT JOIN subjective s ON sd.question_no = s.id AND sd.question_type = '4' WHERE sd.student_no = #{studentNo} AND (sd.student_score IS NULL OR sd.student_score = 0) ORDER BY sd.id DESC

SELECT tq.test_no AS testNo, tq.question_no AS questionNo, tq.question_type AS questionType, CASE WHEN tq.question_type IN ('1','2','3') THEN c.question WHEN tq.question_type = '4' THEN s.question ELSE '未知题型' END AS questionContent, CASE WHEN tq.question_type IN ('1','2','3') THEN c.answer WHEN tq.question_type = '4' THEN s.answer ELSE NULL END AS referenceAnswer FROM test_question tq LEFT JOIN choice c ON tq.question_no = c.id AND tq.question_type IN ('1','2','3') LEFT JOIN subjective s ON tq.question_no = s.id AND tq.question_type = '4' WHERE tq.test_no = #{testNo} ORDER BY tq.id
